description: Record an AI tool invocation as a first-class audit event (event_type=tool_call). Call immediately before executing a tool. Returns tool_call_id to pass to log_tool_result.

tool_call_id.description: Optional ID to link this call to its result. Generated automatically if omitted.

tool_input.description: Tool input parameters as an object

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being called (e.g. "Edit", "Bash", "WebFetch")

name: log_tool_call
